verdict.rationale: Opting out of product telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for a self-hostable observability platform, but the evidence pack never mentions a telemetry or analytics opt-out setting. Self-hosting with 'full control of your data plane' is about where your data lives. It is not a documented switch that disables SigNoz's own usage reporting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
